description.p: deepstock is a native C++ desktop A-share trading terminal demo featuring market data, watchlists, depth, order entry, account workflows, and portfolio views.

ul.li: A-share trading workspace with watchlists, depth, quotes, and order entry
AI chat with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama)
Python analytics (equity, derivatives, fixed income, quant)
Voice commands via offline Whisper speech recognition
Visual workflow node editor with risk management

description.p: Version 4.0.0 — Complete rewrite in native C++20 with Qt6.
